title: DeGLIF for Label Noise Robust Node Classification using GNNs
abstract: arXiv:2506.00244v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Noisy labelled datasets are generally inexpensive compared to clean labelled datasets, and the same is true for graph data. In this paper, we propose a denoising technique DeGLIF: Denoising Graph Data using Leave-One-Out Influence Function. DeGLIF uses a small set of clean data and the leave-one-out influence function to make label noise robust node-level prediction on graph data. Leave-one-out influence function approximates the change in the model parameters if a training point is removed from the training dataset. Recent advances propose a way to calculate the leave-one-out influence function for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). We extend that recent work to estimate the change in validation loss, if a training node is removed from the training dataset. translated_title: 基于GNN的标签噪声鲁棒节点分类的DeGLIF方法
translated_abstract: 带噪声的标记数据集通常比干净标记数据集便宜，图数据也是如此。在本文中，我们提出了一种去噪技术DeGLIF：使用留一法影响函数对图数据进行去噪。DeGLIF利用一小部分干净数据和留一法影响函数，在图数据上实现标签噪声鲁棒的节点级预测。留一法影响函数近似估计了从训练数据集中移除一个训练点时模型参数的变化。最近的研究进展提出了一种计算图神经网络（GNN）留一法影响函数的方法。我们扩展了该工作，以估计从训练数据集中移除一个训练节点时验证损失的变化。我们利用这一估计和一个新的有理论依据的重新标记函数对训练数据集进行去噪。我们提出了两种DeGLIF变体来识别噪声节点。这两种变体均...
tldr: DeGLIF提出了一种利用留一法影响函数和干净数据子集来识别并去噪图数据中的标签噪声，从而提升GNN节点分类鲁棒性的新方法。
en_tdlr: DeGLIF proposes a novel method that leverages the leave-one-out influence function and a small clean subset to identify and denoise label noise in graph data, thereby enhancing the robustness of GNN-based node classification.
